parts.script:
Emily: Hey, Jake! Are you ready for our hike this weekend? 
Jake: I am, but I was thinking we might want to change the trail we originally chose. 
Emily: Oh really? Why's that? 
Jake: Well, I heard the one we picked can get really crowded. I thought we could try the Maple Ridge trail instead. 
Emily: That sounds good! Is it far from here? 
Jake: Not too far, about an hour's drive. It offers some great views and is less populated. Plus, it’s suitable for beginners. 
Emily: Perfect! What should we pack? 
Jake: I suggest we bring water, some snacks, and a first aid kit. Oh, and don’t forget to wear comfortable shoes! 
Emily: Right! I also have a portable charger for our phones, just in case. 
Jake: Good thinking! We should also check the weather before we go. 
Emily: Agreed. I’ll look it up tonight and text you. 
Jake: Great! This is going to be fun. Can’t wait!

questions.question: What trail did Jake suggest instead of the original one?
questions.explanation: Jake suggested the Maple Ridge trail as a better option.

questions.explanation: Emily and Jake plan to pack water and snacks for the hike.

questions.explanation: Jake mentioned that they should check the weather before heading out.
